definitions.de: Sich bewegen; die Position oder den Ort von etwas oder jemandem ändern
definitions.en: To move; to change the position or location of something or someone
definitions.es: Mover; cambiar la posición o ubicación de algo o alguien
definitions.fr: Bouger; changer la position ou l'emplacement de quelque chose ou de quelqu'un
definitions.hi: हिलना/हिलाना; किसी वस्तु या व्यक्ति की स्थिति या जगह बदलना
definitions.ja: 動く・動かす；何かや誰かの位置や場所を変える
definitions.km: ផ្លាស់ទី; ប្តូរទីតាំង ឬទីកន្លែងរបស់អ្វីមួយ ឬអ្នកណាម្នាក់
definitions.ko: 움직이다; 무언가 또는 누군가의 위치나 장소를 바꾸다
definitions.ne: सर्नु/सार्नु; कुनै वस्तु वा व्यक्तिको स्थान वा ठाउँ परिवर्तन गर्नु
definitions.pt: Mover; mudar a posição ou o lugar de algo ou alguém
definitions.th: เคลื่อน; เปลี่ยนตำแหน่งหรือที่อยู่ของบางสิ่งหรือบางคน
definitions.tl: Gumalaw; baguhin ang posisyon o lokasyon ng isang bagay o tao
definitions.ur: حرکت کرنا؛ کسی چیز یا شخص کی پوزیشن یا جگہ بدلنا
definitions.vi: Di chuyển; thay đổi vị trí hoặc chỗ đứng của một vật hoặc một người
definitions.zh: 移动；改变某物或某人的位置或地点
definitions.zh_Hant: 移動；改變某物或某人的位置或地點

definition_en: To move; to change the position or location of something or someone

lao_examples.lao_script: ຊ່ວຍເຄື່ອນໂຕ່ະນັ້ນໄປໄວ້ຢູ່ແຈຫ້ອງແດ່
lao_examples.romanization: Suai khuean to nan pai wai yu jae hong dae.
lao_examples.translation_en: Help me move that table to the corner of the room, please.

lao_examples.lao_script: ລົດນັ້ນບໍ່ໄດ້ເຄື່ອນເລີຍ ອາດຈະເສຍ
lao_examples.romanization: Lot nan bo dai khuean loei, at ja sia.
lao_examples.translation_en: That car hasn't moved at all – it might be broken.
